videos.title: Overtime Episode 077: Smart glasses are the future
videos.description:
Even Realities CEO, Will Wang, joins Overtime to talk about his history with Apple, why Silicon Valley is no longer the place for hardware innovations, insights into the Apple supply chain and China, the Even Realities G2 smart glasses, privacy and the challenges that smart glasses face, and why smart glasses are the future of tech.
